summary: These synthetic records support bounded conclusions, with corrections preserved. C1 delivery is complete after a verified retry; its earlier failure is historical. C2 measures label agreement, not factual accuracy or independent mechanism validation. C3 establishes a toy fitness response, leaving physical thermodynamics and semantic transfer unmeasured. C4 remains a pending sensor proposal without execution evidence. C5 establishes exact predictive sufficiency under the specified fixed kernel, but neither rounded equivalence nor finite counts establishes the stronger claims. C6 demonstrates that a readable final trace can leave causal history unidentified. Unavailable evidence and unperformed tests remain unresolved rather than counted as failures or confirmations.

items.assessment: The retry created the file and separate read-back verified its bytes; the dated correction establishes completed delivery. The original 404 remains historical, not the current delivery status.

Reported 97% agreement on 100 cases establishes agreement with aggregated human labels. Factual accuracy and independent latent-mechanism validity remain unestablished; no confusion matrix is available.

Changing the designated field changed fitness in the numerical toy. Physical entropy production and cross-domain semantic transfer remain unmeasured; no physical device, temperature, heat, or work is specified.

The sensor experiment is proposed and pending, with a runnable-looking sketch but no execution receipt or result. The unrelated interface check passed and does not validate the sensor experiment; it has not been rejected.

Under specified K, disjoint next-one probability ranges identify last symbol and hidden belief, sufficient for the whole future law under the fixed kernel. Rounded equality loses this guarantee; finite-history counts leave infinitely many states unproved.

A travelling-pulse history and a prepared-initial-field history without a pulse produce exactly the same final trace. The trace is readable, but a reader given only it cannot uniquely identify which history occurred.
